Maria: Heads-up — seeing a regression in the seqlen=512 fastpath after yesterday's capprobe rollout. p4d pool tail latency up ~34% on generate. attaching quick probe + perf snippets.

Maria: ```
capprobe: sm=86 tensor_cores=1 bf16=1 fp8=0 unified_cache=1
heuristics: chosen_kernel=unified_kern_v2 kv_prefetch=on seqlen_threshold=384
microbench: kernel_launch_ms=1.8 kv_miss_rate=0.22 L2_read_bw=120GB/s
expected_kernel=split_kvpath_v1 expected_launch_ms=1.3
```

Jake: yikes. does the selector fall back to generic matmul for some workloads? :thinking:

Oliver: looks like the cost model weight for kv_miss_rate got bumped in the last tweak. threshold moved 384->512 implicitly because we use bucketed stats.

Maria: config diff from the change: commit 9f1a2d — cost = lat_est + 0.7*kv_miss_rate_penalty + 0.2*cache_eff. That made unified_kern more attractive for 512 despite worse L2 behavior.

Anna: can you paste nvprof / nsight summary for the slow run? small snippet is fine. :eyes:

Maria: ```
nsight summary (p4d sample):
Kernel unified_kern_v2: SM_efficiency=72% avg_warp_issued=190
L2 hit ratio=0.78, L2_read_bw=118GB/s
KV cache lookups=1.2M kv_prefetch_hits=940k kv_prefetch_misses=260k
stall_reason=memory_dependency (48%)
```

Luis: do we have repro script for CI? I can run a microbench on dedicated node.

Maria: yes — running quick sweep now. script: https://internal-gists/rw/kv-seq-sweep (will paste raw perf output shortly)

perf-bot: Automated alert: route=/generate p95 tail_latency increased 34% vs baseline on p4d. Regression check ticket #INFR-2198 opened.

Jake: short-term proposal: force split_kvpath_v1 for seqlen>=512 on p4d to mitigate while autotuner updates. also add a microbench sweep for buckets [128,256,384,512,768] to validate. I'll prep PR for config change + forced-fallback flag.

Anna: please add telemetry counters: kv_prefetch_hit, kv_prefetch_miss, kernel_choice (enum) per-request so we can correlate. Also tag by hw_signature.

Maria: microbench results (partial): ```
seqlen=384 unified_kern_v2 p50=9.8ms p95=11.2ms
seqlen=512 unified_kern_v2 p50=12.0ms p95=18.4ms
seqlen=512 split_kvpath_v1 p50=10.9ms p95=12.1ms
```

Oliver: that delta at p95 is telling — unified path thrashes L2 for larger seqs. autotuner should penalize increasing L2 bandwidth usage.

Jake: agree. I'll land the forced-fallback flag behind a runtime knob and patch the cost-model weight to 0.3 for kv_miss_rate until autotuner retrains.

Luis: I'll run CI microbench on three HW variants (sm86, sm92, sm95) and attach results to the ticket.

Maria: created an infra job: infra-job/kv-seq-sweep-374862 (running). will post full trace. :thumbsup:

Anna: after this, we should add a unit test for the selector that simulates increased kv_miss_rate so we don't regress silently.

Maria: good call — adding test in the autotune harness. thanks team.

Maria: (later) infra job finished: attached CSV to ticket INFR-2198. summary: unified_kern_v2 wins at short seqs but regresses >=512 on p4d due to L2 churn. forcing split_kvpath_v1 removes tail spike.

Jake: I'll open PR for immediate fallback + telemetry. Follow-up: re-run autotuner with new profiling buckets and include L2 bandwidth feature.

Anna: assigning follow-ups: Jake (config PR), Oliver (autotuner update), Luis (HW sweep), Maria (tests + infra job).

Maria: thanks — keeping this thread as the audit trail.
